lines.text: Many learners say: I have been in Paris last year.
Better: I was in Paris last year.
Was! I was at home last week.

data.wrong: I have been in Paris last year.
data.right: I was in Paris last year.

native.hook: Você diz “I have been last year”?
native.tip: Com “last year” (tempo passado definido), use o passado simples.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “I have been in Paris last year.”. O certo é “I was in Paris last year.”. O “tenho estado” do português engana aqui. Ouça o Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “was”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.hook: Do you say “I have been last year”?
en.tip: With “last year” (a finished time), use the simple past.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “I have been in Paris last year.”. The right way is “I was in Paris last year.”. The Portuguese “tenho estado” is misleading here. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
